name: dashboard-chart
title: DashboardChart
description: Responsive Recharts container with series, axis and reduced-motion helpers.

light.control-overlay: 0 12px 28px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 18%, transparent), 0 4px 8px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent)

.control-primary.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-foreground) 18%, transparent), var(--control-depth)

docs: Requires React 19 and an initialized Tailwind v4 + shadcn project. Installs the Shirtat default theme globally (light/dark, typography, density, focus and motion); review CSS changes. Components and exact UI dependencies live under components/tenboards, helpers under lib/tenboards. No server/data/auth dependencies.
